paper_title: Searching for dark matter with a 1000 km baseline interferometer
suggested_experiment_name: Mainz-Krakow K-Rb-3He comagnetometer interferometer (Advanced GNOME / CASPEr family)

notes: Paper reports new experimental limits from a two-station K-Rb-3He comagnetometer interferometer (Mainz-Krakow, GNOME/CASPEr-related) on g_aNN, g_aPP, and g_aee over masses 1e-22 to 4e-14 eV. AxionNeutron chosen per hint; the paper equally constrains proton (g_aPP < 1e-7 GeV^-1) and electron (g_aee < 1e-6 GeV^-1) couplings, which would be separate extractions. Values may be off by a factor of a few.
